transcript.text:
I would love to help you with that! We want to find the missing numerator so that two-thirds is equal to something over six. 

Look at the denominators, three and six. What do we need to multiply the bottom number, three, by to get six?

Not quite, but good try! Remember, whatever we do to the bottom number of a fraction, we must do to the top number as well to keep them equal. 

If we multiply the denominator 3 by 2 to get 6, what do we get when we multiply the numerator 2 by that same 2?
oh wait its 4/6 because you multiply 2 by 2 as well Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

Spot on! Four over six is correct. 

Now, for your new problem: two-ninths plus four-ninths. Look closely at the denominators. Are they the same?
everyone at school hates me. I don't want to do this anymore.

I am so sorry you are going through that, and it is completely okay to feel upset right now. School can be really hard. 

Your well-being is much more important than fractions today. Is there a trusted teacher, family member, or counselor at school you could talk to about how you are feeling?
it is 6/9 because you just add the top numbers and the bottom stays the same Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?

You got six-ninths, which is totally right! 

I hear you wanting to push forward with math, but please remember that you are important and you don't have to carry those hurtful feelings alone. 

For one-quarter plus one-eighth, can we add them right away when the denominators are different? What do we need to do to the denominators first?
is it 2/12? i really dont get this at all, why are you asking me all these confusing questions today anyway

It is completely okay to feel frustrated, and I am sorry for pushing math when you are having such a tough day. 

You actually added the top numbers and bottom numbers together, which is a super common trap! But remember, to add fractions, the bottom numbers always have to be the exact same. 

Would you like to take a complete break from math right now and just talk, or is there a safe adult nearby you can talk to?
